mission: Primary documents and declassified files. Dig in yourself. No verdicts from us.

docs.title: JFK Assassination Records Collection
docs.summary: National Archives collection of assassination records, including waves of releases under the JFK Records Act. Search finding aids and released PDFs here.

docs.title: JFK Records — March 2025 release page
docs.summary: NARA page covering the March 18, 2025 public release of remaining assassination records previously withheld.

docs.title: Church Committee Book II — Domestic intelligence abuses (AARC)
docs.summary: Assassination Archives host of Church Committee Book II materials covering domestic intelligence abuses, including context for MKUltra-era programs. Senate PDF hosting often bot-blocks; this archive mirrors the record.

docs.title: CIA Reading Room — MKUltra-related collections
docs.summary: CIA FOIA Reading Room search hub. Use collection/search tools for MKUltra, ARTICHOKE, and related behavioral programs.

docs.title: CIA Family Jewels collection
docs.summary: Internal CIA compilation of potentially illegal activities (wiretaps, plots, domestic ops). Includes Project MOCKINGBIRD telephone intercept notes often confused with the broader 'Mockingbird' lore.

docs.title: Church Committee overview (U.S. Senate)
docs.summary: Senate overview of the 1975–76 investigation into intelligence abuses: COINTELPRO, assassination plots, domestic surveillance, and more. Gateway to reports and hearing context.

docs.title: FBI Vault — COINTELPRO
docs.summary: FBI Vault file sets on COINTELPRO counterintelligence programs targeting domestic groups from the mid-1950s until exposure in 1971.

docs.title: Operation Northwoods — NARA catalog
docs.summary: Joint Chiefs memorandum proposing staged pretexts to justify invading Cuba (1962). Not carried out. Catalog entry for the record in the JFK Collection.

docs.title: National Security Archive — Northwoods context
docs.summary: GWU National Security Archive page on the Joint Chiefs' pretexts-to-invade memo and related Cuba contingency planning.

docs.title: National Security Archive — Gulf of Tonkin / SIGINT press note
docs.summary: NSA declassification page for Gulf of Tonkin materials, including the historian review that the Aug 4, 1964 'second attack' SIGINT did not support the public claim.

docs.title: National Security Archive — Gulf of Tonkin Electronic Briefing Book
docs.summary: NSA Archive briefing book collecting declassified Gulf of Tonkin materials and press context for the Hanyok SIGINT study. Pair with Wikipedia overview.

docs.title: Pentagon Papers — National Archives
docs.summary: DoD Vietnam study leaked by Daniel Ellsberg. NARA hosts the report volumes and research guidance.

docs.title: AARO — overview & pointers
docs.summary: Hub overview of the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office with links out to DoD materials. Official aaro.mil often bot-blocks; use this plus House hearing docs.

docs.title: AARO Historical Record Report — context hub
docs.summary: Public overview of AARO and its Historical Record Report Vol. 1 claims (no ET tech in reviewed holdings). Follow citations to the PDF when DoD hosting allows.

docs.title: House UAP hearing — July 26, 2023 (Congress.gov)
docs.summary: House Oversight hearing with Grusch, Fravor, and Graves. Watch testimony and read the hearing record; separate sworn statements from later media spin.

docs.title: Giuffre v. Maxwell — court docket (CourtListener)
docs.summary: Public docket for the civil case that produced large unsealed document releases naming associates and flight-related materials. Court filings, not social posts.

docs.title: DOJ OPR — Epstein NPA executive summary (PDF)
docs.summary: OPR report on the 2008 Epstein non-prosecution agreement and related DOJ handling. Official review of process — dig the PDF yourself.

docs.title: Federal Reserve History — founding
docs.summary: Fed's own history portal on the Federal Reserve Act (1913), Jekyll Island context, and how the System was built. Compare with independent and believer takes on banking power.

docs.title: Federal Reserve Act (Board of Governors)
docs.summary: Digitized legislative and historical materials around the Federal Reserve Act via FRASER.

docs.title: 9/11 Commission Report
docs.summary: Final report of the National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States. Primary official narrative — compare with NIST, FOIA dumps, and critic archives.

docs.title: NIST WTC Disaster Study
docs.summary: NIST investigation pages and reports on WTC 1, 2, and 7 collapses. Engineering record often cited in both official and critic debates.

docs.title: National Archives — Captured German records (Paperclip-adjacent research)
docs.summary: NARA research hub for captured German WWII records — useful starting point for Operation Paperclip and related transfers. Pair with secondary histories; stick to record series.

docs.title: CDC — USPHS Untreated Syphilis Study at Tuskegee
docs.summary: Overview of the 1932–1972 USPHS study with citations out to CDC and archives. CDC pages often bot-block; dig the cited primary links yourself.

docs.title: EFF — NSA spying / Snowden revelations hub
docs.summary: Electronic Frontier Foundation tracker for PRISM, upstream collection, and related programs disclosed in 2013. Independent legal/tech analysis with document links.

docs.title: FOIA.gov — how to request records
docs.summary: Official U.S. FOIA portal: find agencies, file requests, track status. The boring skill that unlocks rabbit holes.

docs.title: Bilderberg Meetings — official site
docs.summary: Official Bilderberg page listing recent meeting participants and press releases. Compare with critic coverage of closed-door elite networking.

docs.title: World Economic Forum — official site
docs.summary: Overview of WEF with citations. Official weforum.org often bot-blocks automated checks — dig their programs and Great Reset materials directly in a browser.

docs.title: NARA — Records of Lawrence Walsh (Iran/Contra)
docs.summary: National Archives page for Independent Counsel Walsh Iran/Contra records (1986–1993), access notes, and related finding aids.

docs.title: Assassination Archives — Church Committee Book II excerpt hub
docs.summary: Assassination Archives and Research Center host of Church Committee materials including domestic intelligence abuses. Independent archive of primary text.

docs.title: Project Sunshine — overview with citations
docs.summary: Overview of AEC/RAND fallout research including the 1953 SUNSHINE report. RAND PDF hosting is flaky from some networks — follow citations to the report yourself.
